doc.brief: The QGridLayout class lays out widgets in a grid.
doc.index_brief: Lays out widgets in a grid

QGridLayout(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a new QGridLayout with parent widget, *parent*.

Qt::Corner originCorner() const.brief: Returns the corner that's used for the grid's origin, i.e. for position (0, 0).

int columnCount() const.brief: Returns the number of columns in this grid.

int columnMinimumWidth(int column) const.brief: Returns the column spacing for column *column*.

int columnStretch(int column) const.brief: Returns the stretch factor for column *column*.

int horizontalSpacing() const.brief: This property holds the spacing between widgets that are laid out side by side

int rowCount() const.brief: Returns the number of rows in this grid.

int rowMinimumHeight(int row) const.brief: Returns the minimum width set for row *row*.

int rowStretch(int row) const.brief: Returns the stretch factor for row *row*.

int spacing() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QLayout::spacing](xref:qt:QLayout).

int verticalSpacing() const.brief: This property holds the spacing between widgets that are laid out on top of each other

void addItem(QLayoutItem *item, int row,.brief: Adds *item* at position *row*, *column*, spanning *rowSpan* rows and *columnSpan* columns, and aligns it according to *alignment*.

void addLayout(QLayout *layout, int row,.brief: Places the *layout* at position (*row*, *column*) in the grid.
This version adds the layout *layout* to the cell grid, spanning multiple rows/columns.

void addWidget(QWidget *widget, int from.brief: This version adds the given *widget* to the cell grid, spanning multiple rows/columns.

void addWidget(QWidget *widget, int row,.brief: Adds the given *widget* to the cell grid at *row*, *column*.

void getItemPosition(int index, int *row.brief: Returns the position information of the item with the given *index*.

void setRowMinimumHeight(int row, int mi.brief: Sets the minimum height of row *row* to *minSize* pixels.

void setRowStretch(int row, int stretch).brief: Sets the stretch factor of row *row* to *stretch*.
